rules.prepare: # The configure script of the release is used as it is. One that is made # again outside of upstream's git repository calls the version # "1.8-unknown" and a beta (autogen.sh --find-version), which Debian # patches away. cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --enable-shared \ --enable-static
